name: The Quiet Divide
description:
Asterion Dynamics finished an overnight maintenance window with an uncomfortable problem: its systems no longer agreed on what had actually happened. A single packet capture was preserved before the environment was taken offline.

Find out what the traffic can prove, and recover the artifact left behind.
